2105-5144-5223-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-5223-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-5223-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

678-728-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-728-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat.

When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
284-4247-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.

728-3240-5632-6462.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

2111-2511-4981.description:

When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2921-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-5033-7893.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-7893.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

3259-3480-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1927-2459-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

215-1129-7297.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6135-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6135-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6135-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

560-1563-2457-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1894-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

101-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and exiling Ephemerate.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Sceptre of Eternal Glory from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sceptre of Eternal Glory onto the battlefield.
When Sceptre of Eternal Glory enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, as Sceptre of Eternal Glory is a land due to Toph, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

Repeat

Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Chameleon.

Activate Chameleon by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {G}.
When Obscuring Aether dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Deathmist Raptor triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face down.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deathmist Raptor, adding one mana of any color.
When Deathmist Raptor dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deathmist Raptor, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.

When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.

You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-2665-4831-4983-5358.description:

Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Progenitor Mimic to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

Animate Candelabra using Toymaker
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.

Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

4084-4095.description:
Cast Part the Waterveil for its awaken cost by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, targeting a land you control.
Holding priority, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}, creating a copy of Part the Waterveil targeting each other applicable land you control.
Resolve the first Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, put six +1/+1 counters on the targeted land and cause it to become a 0/0 Elemental creature until end of turn, and exile Part the Waterveil.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining Part the Waterveil.

When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-1496-3197.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1496-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
